mapper.insert: insert into approval_request ( approval_type, status, run_id, agent_id, agent_version_id, workflow_id, workflow_version_id, node_key, requester_id, requester_type, request_reason, approver_id, decision_comment, decided_at, tool_key, risk_level, arguments_snapshot_json, arguments_digest, expire_at, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{approvalType}, #{status}, #{runId}, #{agentId}, #{agentVersionId}, #{workflowId}, #{workflowVersionId}, #{nodeKey}, #{requesterId}, #{requesterType}, #{requestReason}, #{approverId}, #{decisionComment}, #{decidedAt}, #{toolKey}, #{riskLevel}, #{argumentsSnapshotJson}, #{argumentsDigest}, #{expireAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: select id, approval_type, status, run_id, agent_id, agent_version_id, workflow_id, workflow_version_id, node_key, requester_id, requester_type, request_reason, approver_id, decision_comment, decided_at, tool_key, risk_level, arguments_snapshot_json, arguments_digest, expire_at, created_at, updated_at from approval_request where 1 = 1 and id = #{id} limit 1

select id, approval_type, status, run_id, agent_id, agent_version_id, workflow_id, workflow_version_id, node_key, requester_id, requester_type, request_reason, approver_id, decision_comment, decided_at, tool_key, risk_level, arguments_snapshot_json, arguments_digest, expire_at, created_at, updated_at from approval_request where 1 = 1 and run_id = #{runId} and tool_key = #{toolKey} and status = 'APPROVED' and (expire_at is null or expire_at >= #{now}) order by id desc limit 1

select id, approval_type, status, run_id, agent_id, agent_version_id, workflow_id, workflow_version_id, node_key, requester_id, requester_type, request_reason, approver_id, decision_comment, decided_at, tool_key, risk_level, arguments_snapshot_json, arguments_digest, expire_at, created_at, updated_at from approval_request where 1 = 1 and run_id = #{runId} and tool_key = #{toolKey} and status = 'PENDING' and (expire_at is null or expire_at >= #{now}) order by id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update approval_request set status = 'APPROVED', approver_id = #{approverId}, decision_comment = #{decisionComment}, decided_at = #{decidedAt} where 1 = 1 and id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING'
update approval_request set status = 'REJECTED', approver_id = #{approverId}, decision_comment = #{decisionComment}, decided_at = #{decidedAt} where 1 = 1 and id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select:
select count(1) from approval_request where 1 = 1
and status = #{status}

select id, approval_type, status, run_id, agent_id, agent_version_id, workflow_id, workflow_version_id, node_key, requester_id, requester_type, request_reason, approver_id, decision_comment, decided_at, tool_key, risk_level, arguments_snapshot_json, arguments_digest, expire_at, created_at, updated_at from approval_request where status = 'PENDING' and expire_at is not null and expire_at < #{now} order by expire_at asc, id asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update approval_request set status = 'EXPIRED', decision_comment = #{decisionComment}, decided_at = #{decidedAt} where 1 = 1 and id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING'
